description: Execute up to 1000 event mutations (create/patch/delete) in one Google Calendar HTTP batch request with per-item status/results. Use this to materially reduce round-trips for bulk operations like migrations, cleanup, or large-scale updates.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for batch event operations.

fail_fast.description: If true, stop processing after the first batch containing any 4xx error (except 404 on DELETE). Default is false.
fail_fast.title: Fail Fast

operations.description: List of batch operations to execute. Maximum 1000 operations per request.

items.description: Single operation in a batch request.

body.description: Request body containing event resource data. Required for POST and PATCH, omitted for DELETE.
body.title: Body

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier (email address or 'primary' for main calendar).
calendar_id.title: Calendar Id

event_id.description: Event identifier. Required for PATCH and DELETE operations, omitted for POST (create).
event_id.title: Event Id

method.description: HTTP method for this operation: POST (create event), PATCH (update event), or DELETE (remove event).
method.title: Method

op_id.description: Client-chosen identifier for this operation, used to correlate request with response.
op_id.title: Op Id

query_params.description: Query parameters for the operation (e.g., sendUpdates, conferenceDataVersion, maxAttendees).
query_params.title: Query Params

items.title: BatchOperation

operations.title: Operations

inputSchema.title: BatchEventsRequest

name: batch_events

BatchEventsResponse.description: Response schema for batch event operations.

by_status.description: Count of operations grouped by HTTP status code.
by_status.title: By Status

display_url.description: Collection-level display URL (None for batch operations).
display_url.title: Display Url

results.description: Results for each operation in the same order as the request operations.
results.title: Results

BatchEventsResponse.title: BatchEventsResponse

BatchOperationResult.description: Result of a single batch operation.

display_url.description: URL to view this event in Google Calendar web UI (from API htmlLink field), or None if unavailable.
display_url.title: Display Url

error.description: Error details if the operation failed (parsed JSON error response).
error.title: Error

event.description: Event resource data for successful POST/PATCH operations. Omitted for DELETE or failed operations.
event.title: Event

http_status.description: HTTP status code for this operation (e.g., 200, 201, 204, 400, 404, 409).
http_status.title: Http Status

op_id.description: Operation identifier matching the request op_id.
op_id.title: Op Id

BatchOperationResult.title: BatchOperationResult
